image_description: A high-angle shot of a steep, sunlit cliff face composed of layered sedimentary rock. The rock exhibits vertical weathering streaks and erosion patterns. In the lower left foreground, green trees and shrubs cling to the slope. At the bottom right, a body of water is visible with a small boat or structure near the shore. The lighting suggests late afternoon or early morning sunlight hitting the upper portion of the cliff.

The object in the water (possibly a boat or dock) lacks clear structural definition and blends ambiguously with the water surface, exhibiting slight geometric incoherence typical of AI-generated background elements.

To verify the spatial relationship between the vertical cliff, the foreground vegetation, and the water below, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.
To check if the trees merging with the rock face have clean boundaries or if they exhibit 'melting' into the stone, a common AI artifact.
To assess the overall coherence of lighting and texture consistency across the large rock surface.

Geometric plausibility of the water-line and boat structure
